import sys
import heapq

def max_items_without_horn(n, X, prices):
    # Sort the prices in ascending order
    prices.sort()
    
    # Use a min-heap to keep track of the smallest sums of pairs
    min_heap = []
    
    # Iterate through the prices and try to form pairs
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            pair_sum = prices[i] + prices[j]
            # If the pair sum is greater than X, we cannot include both items
            if pair_sum > X:
                # Push the pair sum into the heap
                heapq.heappush(min_heap, pair_sum)
    
    # The number of items we can mark as participating
    max_participating = 0
    
    # We need to exclude the minimum number of items to ensure no valid pair exists
    while min_heap:
        # Pop the smallest pair sum
        smallest_pair_sum = heapq.heappop(min_heap)
        # Find the indices of the items that form this pair
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                if prices[i] + prices[j] == smallest_pair_sum:
                    # Exclude one of the items in this pair
                    max_participating = max(max_participating, n - 1)
                    break
            else:
                continue
            break
    
    return max_participating
